contexts.text: (Evil Spirits) are excused when they do evil, when they are in any use.
They say that they acknowledge one Supreme Being... which is excused with those who are outside the Church.
As rational truth is of such a character, it is excused, and is allowed to be in appearances...
This is excused with them, because it is said from despair.
As no one has known that there is a spiritual sense in everything of the Word, they who have taken up this opinion concerning the Last Judgment are excused. Ath 4.

Still, they who have made themselves atheists by means of confirmations in favour of nature are not to be excused, because they could have confirmed themselves in favour of the Divine; ignorance does indeed excuse, but does not take away confirmed falsity; because this falsity coheres with evil, thus with Hell...
The Angels replied... All in Hell have the ideas of their thoughts immersed in the senses of the body, and cannot elevate their minds above them, and therefore we excuse you...
Some are to be excused for having ascribed visible things to nature; because they knew nothing about the Sun of the Spiritual World, nor...
He was such interiorly, that he could never forgive anyone who had once seemed to do evil to him... SE 3216:end.
